nuggets.text: Clark Lea played college baseball at Birmingham-Southern and Belmont before becoming a fullback at Vanderbilt.
The Commodores wear gold jerseys Saturday for the first time since 2020, and the first 8,000 fans get a replica.
The Commodores' opener against Austin Peay was called with 2:16 left because of lightning near the stadium.
Martel Hight returned a blocked extra point for two points in the Commodores' opener.
Josiah Broxton returned a rushed punt 27 yards for a touchdown against Austin Peay.
Jared Curtis, who flipped from Georgia last December, is the first five-star signee in Vanderbilt history.
In 2024, the Commodores beat No. 1 Alabama 40-35, their first-ever win over an AP top-5 team.
The Commodores climbed to No. 9 in the AP poll in 2025, their highest ranking since 1937.
The first official Mr. Commodore, in 1954, wore a uniform built to 1873 U.S. Navy full-dress specifications.
The Commodores are named for founder Cornelius Vanderbilt, nicknamed the Commodore for his empire of ships and railroads.
